Thailand has stronger recent form (4W 3D 1L) and superior stats (56% possession, 11.6 shots). However, China benefits from significant home advantage in Beijing and has naturalized players (Browning, Seko, Dai) adding quality. Thailand's possession-based approach may struggle against China's compact home defense. H2H at senior level has been tight, including a 0-0 draw in January 2026. This friendly should be closely contested with China having a slight home edge.
